top_signals.title: Hedge Fund Titan Rokos Said to Quit UK for Greece
top_signals.summary: Chris Rokos, the founder of Rokos Capital Management, is set to leave the UK and switch his residency to Greece, people with knowledge of the arrangement said. Rokos will also open an office in Athens as part of the move, one of the people said. He is the latest in a string of high-profile financiers and business leaders that have chosen to leave after the abolition of the UK's long-standing non-dom regime and increased taxes on everything from private equity investments to inheritances and capital gains. Bloomberg's Jack Sidders reports. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Art Worth €9 Million Stolen From Renoir Museum on French Riviera
top_signals.summary: Thieves broke into a Renoir museum on the French Riviera and stole works of art worth €9 million ($10.5 million), the latest in a string of heists that has exposed security lapses at European galleries.
